 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Stubbal"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Stubble"**, which refers to the short stalks that are left in the field after crops like wheat or barley have been harvested. (खेत में कटाई के बाद बचा हुआ डंठल)

 
 
• **Example:** The farmer burned the stubble left in his fields after harvesting the wheat.
 
 
 
• The correct word **"Stubble"** also has the same meaning and is correctly spelt. (खेत में कटाई के बाद बचा हुआ डंठल)
 
 
• **Example:** Walking through the stubble, we admired the beauty of the countryside.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Stubbal" is incorrect, and the correct spelling is "Stubble".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Taciturn** (मौन): Quiet or reserved in speech; not inclined to talk much.

 
 
• **Example:** The taciturn man sat in the corner, observing everything but saying nothing.
 
 
 
• **Outsource** (आउटसोर्स): To obtain goods or services from an external supplier, usually to reduce costs.
 
 
• **Example:** Many companies outsource their customer service to other countries.
 
 
 
• **Particulate** (सूक्ष्म कण): Relating to small particles, especially those found in the air, such as dust or pollutants.
 
 
• **Example:** The air quality in the city worsened due to high levels of particulate matter.
